# Argos - Technical Website Audit

## What is Argos?

Argos is a free technical audit tool for a public URL, with no account required,
that provides a private report with scores and recommendations for performance,
security, SEO and accessibility.

## What Argos analyzes

Argos examines the submitted public page over HTTP or HTTPS. Automated checks
cover four areas: performance, security, SEO and accessibility. They use HTTP
headers, HTML structure, TLS checks, browser metrics and Lighthouse results.
Runtime (Playwright) supplies performance measurements; it is not a separate
scoring category. Tech stack detection provides additional context.

## Report and privacy

- An overall score and scores for performance, security, SEO and accessibility.
- Prioritized issues with recommendations and effort estimates.
- A private, non-indexable report accessed through a unique token-based URL.
- No account or login required. Anyone with the report link can view it.

The audit covers the submitted page, not every page of the website. Automated
checks provide an initial technical diagnosis and do not replace a manual audit.

## Digital accessibility guide: RGAA and EAA

Public guide: https://argos.lelouet.fr/ressources/accessibilite-numerique

The French canonical article explains the four WCAG principles, which organisations and
consumer services may be covered by French Article 47/RGAA or the European Accessibility
Act, the practical duties, and conditional penalties. It cites DINUM, EUR-Lex, Légifrance,
DGCCRF and W3C. The article was reviewed on 6 October 2026 and is also readable in English
using Argos's language switch. Argos can identify some technical accessibility signals,
but its automated report is not a complete RGAA/WCAG audit, a compliance certificate, or
legal advice.
